integration: Keep the monorepo shell, design system, shared dialogs and real-brain example manifest.
Adapt PipelineExecutor to QsmPipelineController and the shared WorkerSession protocol.
Fetch model weights through the shared downloader with upstream hashes and a pinned Hugging Face revision.
Build both WASM bundles with the repository's pinned nightly toolchain and shared cross-origin isolation support.
Keep monorepo date-based release versions and deployment workflows.
Load Inter from css/inter.css, which pins the Google Fonts v20 files, not from the mutable fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet.

Keep Cite owned by the shared shell. Read the command from #commandPreviewText after app.showCommandPreview().

Keep `@playwright/test` and `yaml` declared as exact devDependencies for the monorepo e2e suite; the dependency checker rejects tooling resolved through another workspace's or the root's node_modules.
Keep the monorepo idle status: #statusText starts as "Drag and drop files" (design system); the window-wide drop comes from the shared components.

Keep the canonical Neurodesk workspace and shared controls. The upstream next.html/Preact preview is not imported; run its engine oracle separately against the pinned source when validating scientific changes.

Load dicompare's embed, worker and schemas from https://webapps.neurodesk.org/dicompare/ (this repository's deployment of apps/dicompare/public), not dicompare.neurodesk.org, whose GitHub Pages site stopped serving in October 2026; the rewrite keeps upstream's URLs pointed there.
